selected_primary.used_for: Conserved covariant momenta in Bianchi I and mass-shell expressions for density and principal stress. The finite quadrature derivative is derived directly in this unit; asymptotic theorems are not transferred to the present mixed matter/radiation/Lambda closure.

selected_primary.title: CVODES Mathematical Considerations
selected_primary.used_for: Forward state and parameter sensitivities satisfy the chain-rule variational equation, with initial derivatives retained. Analytic JVPs can be supplied without a stored dense Jacobian. Only the mathematical structure is reused; no CVODES dependency or performance claim is introduced.
